reserves.name: Current Monetrix strategy and custody envelope (unreconciled)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Monetrix strategy accounts, MonetrixVault, and undisclosed venue or custody counterparties

reserveReview.rationale: Monetrix documents USDC as the mint input and deploys backing into a delta-neutral Hyperliquid spot-plus-short strategy. On the 2026-07-28 re-open, the live collateral API explicitly returned backing.reconciled=false: backing.totalUsd was not presented as a non-double-counted sum of spotUsd, marginUsd, and the signed bufferUsd. The positions API separately mixed spot value, perpetual notional, and a negative idle-USDC value. Those fields do not establish that the current backing remains a 100% USDC reserve slice. The prior USDC look-through is therefore replaced by one unlinked strategy and custody envelope until Monetrix publishes a reconciled reserve equation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Monetrix's documented USDC mint input plus live but explicitly unreconciled strategy, collateral, and supply telemetry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current non-double-counted spot, margin, hedge, idle-liquidity, custody, and redemption-backing amounts are not published as a reconciled reserve composition.
